parsed.explanation: No presentation offence or border/facility ban is documented, and hate-crime law produced a 2020 conviction of three police officers for killing a trans woman. Against that, the worst documented feature is Tier 1/2: under the post-2022 exception regime trans women are arbitrarily captured in mass raids and held in birth-sex prisons with documented forced shaving, punitive drills, denial of HIV care and a prison environment targeting effeminate behaviour with sexual assault, with no effective remedy. Gang targeting, extortion, police refusal to cooperate in death investigations, and HRW findings of entrenched unaddressed violence compound this, as does 85% survey acceptance of attacking a trans person. The single conviction shows some recourse, but does not remedy the recurring custody/state targeting.
